scope: Developer Electron loads real desktop/main.cjs and build-desktop UI. Explicit global --no-sandbox; all IP responses are simulated and real HTTP is blocked.

checks.description: 420x350 transparent document, draggable toolbar, non-draggable window controls, no document overflow
All five compact panels, panel-close controls and window buttons remain inside the viewport
Real window expands to 640x490 and all five panels remain contained
Toolbar shrinks the real window back to 420x350
Pin toolbar button durably saves both directions and immediately changes the native always-on-top state
Minimize button minimizes the native window, which restores through native APIs (taskbar click not tested)
Simulated offline/online events automatically replace Guangdong IP with Beijing and freely retain both unlocks without asset/home/game-location changes
Focus after automatic throttle rechecks IP through production event bindings (clock advanced, mocked response)
Production two-minute timer rechecks IP without a button click (clock advanced, mocked response)
Production IPC falls back from primary HTTP403 to IPWhois, unlocks freely, and weather failure does not erase a successful IP location
Weather recovers at the same IP coordinates through its own retry/manual control without resetting assets or requiring a location change
Both providers failing is visibly a cached IP result while online weather remains separate; shareable diagnostics contain no coordinates or paths
X exits normally and flushes the chosen window preset and programmatically changed position
Restart restores window position/preset and saved pin/offline settings and assets; X exits again
